subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw support `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a public embedded-runtime-only setting while native Codex compaction deliberately ignores it with a warning?
rationale: This is a new configuration capability rather than a repair to an established contract; code and tests can establish its mechanics but cannot decide whether the cross-runtime product contract is worth expanding.

options.title: Approve the scoped setting
options.body: Accept the embedded-only override, its documented native-Codex no-op warning, and the accompanying compatibility contract.

options.title: Decline the new config surface
options.body: Keep compaction tied to the session thinking level and avoid exposing a runtime-dependent option.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped setting
recommendation.body: Accept the embedded-only override, its documented native-Codex no-op warning, and the accompanying compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent direct implementation commits make steipete the strongest available owner for the public-runtime contract decision.
